name: Emberstar Ventfield
introDiscord:
"Blue-white vents glow across a field of scorched starstone. Emberstar Urchins cluster around the warmest openings like tiny spiked bathers who have claimed every good seat."

---------------- ROOM 1 ----------------
introTwitch:
"Blue-white vents glow across a field of scorched starstone. Emberstar Urchins cluster around the warmest openings like tiny spiked bathers who have claimed every good seat."

---------------- ROOM 1 ----------------

emberstar-ventfield-approach.prompt: Blue fire breathes from cracks across the ventfield. Three routes weave between eruptions while Emberstar Urchins occupy every comfortable patch of warm stone.

left.message: A cooled vent has cracked open a cometglass seam full of Star Candies. Several Urchins stare at you like you've opened their emergency snack cupboard.

right.message:
An Emberstar Urchin sits directly in the route.

You approach.

It raises every glowing spine.

Apparently the path is reserved.

forward.message: Shizuki left a heatproof bottle beside a vent marked with three worried arrows. "Emberroot tonic. Significantly safer than drinking directly from vent."
forward.fullHpMessage:
"You leave the tonic alone. Experimenting with Shizuki's definition of 'significantly safer' seems unnecessary."

---------------- ROOM 2 ----------------

emberstar-ventfield-depths.prompt: Deeper inside, eruptions travel across the seabed in glowing sequences. Three routes open while Urchins casually shuffle between warm spots.

left.message:
An Urchin rolls away from its vent.

For half a second this seems generous.

The vent erupts beneath you.

That felt intentional.

right.message: A narrow gap between dormant vents hides an old star-chart coffer. The lid is pleasantly warm. The Star Candies inside thankfully are not.

forward.message:
"One Berry rests inside Shizuki's scorched cooking pan.

"Attempted vent-cooked berries.

Results classified as charcoal.

Glimmer now considers itself a culinary expert.""

---------------- ROOM 3 ----------------

emberstar-ventfield-threshold.prompt: The innermost ventfield glows almost white. Blue flames burst from the stone in overlapping rhythms around three narrow approaches.

left.message:
A tiny shelter contains Shizuki's bottle and three instructions:

"Hot vent: wait.
Cold vent: cross.
Urchin sitting on vent: reconsider career."
left.fullHpMessage: The bottle remains safely inside the shelter. You can reconsider your career without medicinal assistance.

right.message:
Every nearby Urchin rolls away from this route.

The stone begins glowing beneath you.

One Urchin remains directly ahead.

Unfortunately, it may have the tactical advantage.

forward.message:
"Several Urchins form a circle around a cooled meteor fragment.

They move aside.

A Star Candy cache sits underneath.

Apparently you interrupted a meeting."

---------------- BOSS — ASHEN CONSTELLATION ----------------

boss-antechamber.name: Ashen Constellation
boss-antechamber.prompt: The vents erupt one after another until blue flames connect into an enormous constellation across the seabed.

bossPromptDiscord:
The final vent erupts beneath an enormous crown of glowing spines.

Every ordinary Emberstar Urchin immediately rolls away.

Something rises from the blue fire like a tiny, extremely furious sun.

Use /yes to approach the Ashen Constellation or /no to retreat somewhere with fewer opportunities to become soup.
bossPromptTwitch:
The final vent erupts beneath an enormous crown of glowing spines.

Every ordinary Emberstar Urchin immediately rolls away.

Something rises from the blue fire like a tiny, extremely furious sun.

Use !yes to approach the Ashen Constellation or !no to retreat somewhere with fewer opportunities to become soup.
bossRetreatText: You back away. Several ordinary Urchins appear impressed by your sudden respect for personal space.

boss.revealText:
The central vent explodes in blue-white fire.

Cinder-Crown Urchin awakens!

completionText:
"The Cinder-Crown Urchin retreats into the cooling ventfield.

Several ordinary Urchins immediately reclaim the arena like bathers returning to reserved spa chairs.

One has already taken the warmest spot.

Of course."
